title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Rapid accumulation of multiple oxidizing equivalents and accessible cobalt sites were linked to higher oxygen-evolution activity in a compared high-nuclearity Co-POM series.
explanation: Flash-photolysis measurements on Co9, Co15, and Co16 POMs were compared with their water-oxidation performance; the review additionally identifies exposed satellite cobalt sites in Co15 as potential locations for water attack.
conditions: Visible-light water oxidation with a ruthenium photosensitizer.
caveats: The mechanistic linkage is specific to the studied series and should not be extrapolated solely from cobalt nuclearity.
